blockers.was: 'Only PMC7563993 has a bibliographic record anywhere in this repository. The other three exist solely as characters inside this one sentence and its copies ... PMC12398172 could not be independently characterised from outside this sandbox's egress block.'
blockers.is: Measured repository-wide 2026-08-26: PMC12398172 is Masunaga 2025 (J Orthop Surg Res, doi 10.1186/s13018-025-06245-6, n=171 Japanese national registry) with a full record at registry.citations.masunaga2025 in research/data/emc-clinical-registry.json and references in 25 tracked files; PMC9131214 is pmid 35665108 (World J Clin Cases 2022, doi 10.12998/wjcc.v10.i13.4301) with a record in research/literature/rt-lung-mets-probe.json; only PMC12376927 is genuinely unbacked here, and web search characterises it as a single-patient buttock-EMC case report. The DEFECT IS MISATTRIBUTION: a national-registry outcome cohort and two case reports cited as 'the review literature'. Removing all three stands; the reason given did not.
blockers.provenance_of_the_error: It originated in this project's own SEAT-B4 finding (CYC-0002), which searched ONE artifact and generalised the miss to the repository, and was written into the manuscript by CYC-0003 acting on it faithfully. A wrong finding acted on faithfully becomes a wrong claim in the paper -- which is the argument for the regression seat that caught it.
